hosts.label: Hosts
hosts.description: One entry per host, written as Name=address. An entry with no = is used as both.

interval_seconds.label: Ping interval (seconds)
interval_seconds.description: How often each host is pinged. The ping timeout is one second less than this.

threshold_good.label: Good below (ms)
threshold_good.description: Round trips under this are shown in the good colour.

threshold_warning.label: Warning below (ms)
threshold_warning.description: Round trips under this are shown in the warning colour; anything higher is critical.

bar_host.label: Bar host
bar_host.description: Name of the host the bar widget shows. Leave empty to show whichever host is currently worst.

show_host_name.label: Show host name
show_host_name.description: Prefix the bar reading with the host name.
